messages:
maya: rolling hippo13b-int4 into canary (rack-3). seeing OOMs on longer completions, looks like fragmentation rather than pure alloc failure. ~15% of requests over 800 tokens blow up
aj: logs? stack traces?
maya: pasting small snippet from canary node:

maya: ```
2026-03-19T22:03:12Z ERROR serve: allocation failed: cudaOutOfMemory
  model=hippo13b-int4, ctx=1.2k tokens, batch=4, reserved=0.45GB, free=0.20GB
  kv-cache-shrink attempted, evicted 12 slots, still OOM
```

sam: interesting — kv eviction ran but didn't free contiguous pages. fragmentation symptom. what are current defaults for this model?
maya: default we shipped from onboarding: batch_size=4, max_new_tokens=1024, prefetch=true, kv_eviction=lru, kv_trim_threshold=0.35
aj: quick suggestion: drop batch to 2 for canary, lower max_new_tokens to 512 as gate, and enable soft-throttle to reject/queue long requests instead of letting them allocate and fail
eva: how about adjusting kv_eviction to active-shrink (coalesce freed blocks) + reduce kv_trim_threshold to 0.25? that might make evictions more aggressive and reduce fragmentation risk
sam: agree. also add a small warmup to prefill prefixes for common prompts — contiguous allocation pattern helps CUDA allocator reduce fragmentation
maya: proposed patched canary config:

maya: ```yaml
model: hippo13b
precision: int4
canary: true
batch_size: 2
max_new_tokens: 512
prefetch: true
soft_throttle:
  enabled: true
  queue_limit: 3
kv_eviction: active-shrink
kv_trim_threshold: 0.25
warmup_prefixes: ["summarize:", "explain:"]
```

aj: run microbench first — we should measure latency and OOM rate delta. can you run 1k requests with real-ish token distribution (mix of short/long)?
maya: running now, will push results in ~20m. launching infra job via deploy-bot.

infra-bot: deploy started: canary_config/hippo13b/3418009999 -> rack-3 (2 nodes)

20m later...
maya: initial microbench results:

maya: ```
baseline (batch4,max1024): OOM rate=14.7%, p95 latency=420ms
patched (batch2,max512,active-shrink,soft-throttle): OOM rate=1.2%, p95 latency=490ms (under throttling), p50 unchanged
notes: ~6% of requests were queued by soft-throttle, 0.6% rejected beyond queue_limit
```

sam: tradeoff looks fine — small p95 hit but huge OOM reduction. for user-facing defaults we should avoid rejections; recommend canary -> 10% rollout with these settings and telemetry to detect quality/regression
aj: tiny followups: add eviction debugging metrics (contiguous_free_bytes, fragmentation_ratio) and KV compaction run every 2h during rollout window
eva: agreed. I'll add metrics to console dashboard and an alert if fragmentation_ratio > 0.6
maya: rollout plan: start 10% traffic for 6h, monitor OOM rate / p95 / fragmentation, then 30% -> full if stable. will also run a quality eval on 200 prompts to ensure int4 quality not regressing under new defaults
sam: please note: for Dedicated customers we should keep more permissive max_new_tokens (they have reserved capacity) — patch only for hosted fallback and canary
aj: ACK. I'll draft a short runbook for oncall (how to flip soft-throttle, rollback kv_eviction)
maya: thanks — will update thread with the 6h telemetry snapshot. ping me if you want to join verification window. :thumbsup:
